Address of the upgraded token contract used when deprecated.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body executes.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
newOwner is written into the owner state variable.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping inside BasicToken.transfer.
_to parameter flows into transfer.
_value parameter flows into transfer.
BasicToken.transfer updates the balances mapping.
fee local is derived from _value.
Computed fee is credited to the owner balance entry.
sendAmount local is derived from _value minus fee.
sendAmount is credited to the recipient balance entry.
basisPointsRate is read when computing the transfer fee.
maximumFee caps the computed transfer fee.
_from parameter flows into StandardToken.transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into StandardToken.transferFrom.
_allowance local is read from allowed[_from][msg.sender].
_allowance is used to update the allowed mapping.
StandardToken.transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
msg.sender is used as spender key in the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is used as owner key in the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
pause is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
unpause is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
pause sets paused = true.
unpause sets paused = false.
addBlackList is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_evilUser parameter flows into addBlackList.
addBlackList writes isBlackListed mapping.
removeBlackList is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
removeBlackList writes isBlackListed mapping.
destroyBlackFunds is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_blackListedUser parameter flows into destroyBlackFunds.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the blacklisted user.
destroyBlackFunds executes the unchecked _totalSupply subtraction.
dirtyFunds local is derived from the blacklisted user's balance.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the _totalSupply state variable.
EpayToken.transfer performs an external call to the upgraded contract when deprecated.
super.transfer is invoked when the token is not deprecated.
Blacklist require statements gate the caller in EpayToken.transfer.
EpayToken.transferFrom performs an external call to the upgraded contract when deprecated.
super.transferFrom is invoked when the token is not deprecated.
Blacklist require statements gate the caller in EpayToken.transferFrom.
deprecated flag decides the delegation path in transfer.
deprecated flag decides the delegation path in transferFrom.
upgradedAddress is the target of the transferByLegacy external call.
upgradedAddress is the target of the transferFromByLegacy external call.
EpayToken.approve delegates to super.approve when not deprecated.
deprecate sets deprecated = true.
deprecate sets upgradedAddress.
deprecate is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_upgradedAddress parameter flows into deprecate.
issue is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
issue executes raw addition on _totalSupply and owner balance.
amount parameter flows into issue.
Raw addition mutates the _totalSupply state variable.
issue credits the owner balance entry.
redeem is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
redeem executes raw subtraction on _totalSupply and owner balance.
amount parameter flows into redeem.
Raw subtraction mutates the _totalSupply state variable.
redeem debits the owner balance entry.
setParams is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
newBasisPoints parameter flows into setParams.
newMaxFee parameter flows into setParams.
setParams writes basisPointsRate.
setParams writes maximumFee.
msg.sender is used in the allowed mapping write inside approve.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is the only input parameter of transferOwnership and should be folded into the function node.
_to is a transfer recipient parameter fully determined by BasicToken.transfer.
_value is the amount parameter consumed by BasicToken.transfer.
_from is the source parameter consumed by StandardToken.transferFrom.
fee is a transient local computed and consumed only inside BasicToken.transfer.
sendAmount is a transient local computed and consumed only inside BasicToken.transfer.
amount is the only input parameter of EpayToken.issue.
amount is the only input parameter of EpayToken.redeem.
_evilUser is the only input parameter of addBlackList.
_blackListedUser is the only input parameter of destroyBlackFunds.
newBasisPoints is an input parameter of setParams.
newMaxFee is an input parameter of setParams.
dirtyFunds is a transient local feeding the unchecked subtraction unsafe operation.
_upgradedAddress is the only input parameter of deprecate.
_allowance is a transient local computed and consumed only inside StandardToken.transferFrom.
